ma.switchTab(Object object)

The tabBar page is displayed, and all non-tabBar pages are closed.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
url String Yes Path (code package path) of the tabBar page to be redirected to (the page defined by the tabBar field in the app.json file). The path cannot contain any parameter.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used regardless of whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

{
  "tabBar": {
    "list": [
      {
        "pagePath": "index",
        "text": "Home"
      },
      {
        "pagePath": "other",
        "text": "Others"
      }
    ]
  }
}

ma.switchTab({
  url: '/index'
});
